body:
Hi MohammadHossein,
 
I hope you are doing well.
I seem to have a few technical issues.
On is that one participant has their time use diary showing each time the previous day and not the current day (see attached screenshot from Tuesday), and cannot do anything to change it.
This is the subject labeled as 124.
 
Another thing is that we realized that when we donwnload the data, at least when it comes to the time use data, we sometimes not get all the data. Yesterday for example when I downloaded the data we did not have there participant 126. After asking her and her saying she did fill it out we checked again.
It appeared on when doing an inquiry on the websites. We downloaded it again and then it was there (but only after few attempts of downloading), today something similar happened. This is crucial, and beyond the obvious need of having all participants data it makes me wonder if sometimes when I download the data I don’t really get all of my data (as there are potentially insertions recorded but missing in the downloaded data).
 
Could you please check this.
 
Thank you,
Rani
Please note this is a split from z-12479. That's why it shows me as the client!!

subject: Problem with Time Use entries
body:
Dear Rani,

Could you please verify the date and time settings on the participant's device to ensure they are accurate? Additionally, check the participant's TimeZone settings to confirm correctness. If possible, set these options to automatic, reload the studies from the app, and inform me of the outcome.

Best regards,
Alireza

Note: If you feel like your issue is not properly being addressed and want to escalate it, please click here: https://avicennaresearch.com/app/public/zammad/escalate/24768/ad06b88f9a205505
